name: Boffin
ability: The Demon (even if drunk or poisoned) has a not-in-play good character’s ability. You both know which.
designRole: Gives the Demon a not-in-play good ability; demands detailed ability and jinx review.
explanation: Gives the Demon a not-in-play good ability; demands detailed ability and jinx review.

nightInstructions.firstNight: Wake the Boffin and the Demon. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Boffin tokens, then the not-in-play good character token.

storytellerNotes: List plausible not-in-play good abilities and consult all relevant jinxes before running.

jinxes.reason: If the Alchemist has the Boffin ability, the Alchemist does not learn what ability the Demon has.
If the Demon has the Cult Leader ability, they can’t turn good due to this ability.
The Demon cannot have the Drunk ability.
If the Demon has the Goon ability, they can’t turn good due to this ability.
The Demon cannot have the Heretic ability.
The Demon cannot have the Ogre ability.
The Demon cannot have the Politician ability.
If there is a spare token, the Boffin can give the Demon the Village Idiot ability.
